checkRuns.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='app/pages/contact.vue'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    if (!valid) setResponseStatus(event, 422)\n","")
s=s.replace("  } catch {\n    state.value.errors = {}\n  } finally {","  } finally {")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -25

bun add h3@^1.15.11 2>&1 | tail -2; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='app/pages/contact.vue'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("<script setup lang=\"ts\">\n","<script setup lang=\"ts\">\nimport { readBody } from 'h3'\n\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
head -5 app/pages/contact.vue; bun run check && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2
